reasoning_model.uncertainty: Whether headline power, unit ratios or price increases represent comparable economic content.
reasoning_model.evidence: Configuration, wafer content, workload role, product generation and like-for-like price.
reasoning_model.causal_chain: physical system mix → device/tool content → qualified volume × price → revenue and margin
reasoning_model.transmission: AI capex sets system demand; architecture allocates content; supplier share and pricing determine company cash flow and valuation.
reasoning_model.bridge: Revenue = systems × content/system × share × ASP; margin requires cost recovery and mix separately.
reasoning_model.assumptions: Units, periods and product generations are normalized.
reasoning_model.validity: Semis, equipment and heterogeneous AI systems.
reasoning_model.counterexample: A software or service bottleneck dominates value while physical content is stable.
reasoning_model.falsification: Normalized content/price bridge misses reported segment revenue for two quarters without an identified timing item.
